name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA API coverage, fixed typed SDK reads, design operations and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover control, schematics, PCB layout, libraries, manufacturing, design review and extensions. The facade provides a complete per-method coverage inventory, fixed typed reads with explicit public/native labels, guarded typed API operations, closed symbol/page metadata updates, closed empty-page and empty-symbol creation, existing-tab activation, inactive clean-tab close, native controls, checkpoints and recovery. Native schematic Text/Wire/Bus ID equivalents avoid public callback/compiler paths. A checkpoint-bound flat topology diagnostic and a sealed single-page display-only transaction profile have separate narrow contracts. Generic compiled topology and dependent transactions remain blocked for hidden annotation and Save All; affected exports are refused. Bounded observations do not replace complete source, connectivity or saved-project proof. The historical reviewed external tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed. Historical live evidence remains generation-specific; new adapters need disposable validation. Runtime identity and operation-specific evidence remain mandatory. Arbitrary JavaScript, blind retry and unrestricted Save are refused; the legacy writer is runtime-disabled.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
